# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthians is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the verbs: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. None of these are passive. Each one demands intention, discipline, and courage. The world will tell you that strength is optional, that conviction is outdated, and that comfort is king. But Scripture calls us to something higher. Being watchful means keeping your eyes on your enemy and your heart guarded against compromise. Standing firm means refusing to drift when culture pushes. Acting like men means taking responsibility instead of shrinking back. Being strong means building spiritual muscle through prayer, Scripture, and obedience—long before the storm hits. Strength isn't forged in the easy moments; it's built in the daily grind of faithfulness. Today, you get to choose. Will you coast, or will you train? Will you let the world shape you, or will you stand firm in the faith? The battle is real, but so is the God who goes before you.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups while thanking God for the strength to stand firm—and commit one area of your life to Him before you start your day.
